morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词记忆；结尾-an不是马来语后缀。规范书写首字母大写。

senses.zh_definition: 布赖恩：人名，通常用作男性名字，也可用作姓氏；具体所指由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A usually masculine given name, a variant of Brian; also a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama lelaki dan juga boleh menjadi nama keluarga.
senses.nuances: 不是具有普通词义的马来语词。Bryan与Brian是相关的姓名拼写，但记录具体个人姓名时不可互换。音标为常见英语读法，实际应尊重本人读音。马来语释义为说明性编写，并非DBP原文。名字关系见[Brian](https://www.behindthename.com/name/brian)，姓氏用法见[Bryan](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/bryan)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 会议安排
dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Bryan akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 布赖恩先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Bryan will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Bryan dah sampai kat kafe, jom pergi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Bryan sudah tiba di kafe; mari kita pergi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 布赖恩已经到咖啡馆了，走吧。
dual_scenarios.en: Bryan's already at the café. Let's go.
spoken_features: kat在此相当于表示地点的di。
jom用于轻松地邀请对方一起行动。

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Bryan dah sampai kat kafe ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Bryan sudah tiba di kafe?
messages.zh: 布赖恩已经到咖啡馆了吗？
messages.en: Is Bryan at the café already?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat dalam je. Jom!
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, dia hanya menunggu di dalam. Mari kita pergi!
messages.zh: 到了，他就在里面等着。走吧！
messages.en: Yeah, he's just waiting inside. Let's go!

etymology.historical_story: Bryan is a spelling variant of Brian, an Irish personal name whose earliest meaning remains uncertain. Proposed connections involve Celtic words associated with height or strength, but these are hypotheses rather than a secure translation. The name Brian was borne by the medieval Irish king Brian Boru. Bryan later also became a surname. See [the name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/brian) and [surname entry](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/bryan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语读音近“布赖恩”；把Bryan想成通讯录里的一个人名，避免将末尾-an当成马来语后缀。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 初次或正式接触时，可按对方身份使用Encik Bryan或其实际职衔；熟悉后按本人偏好称呼Bryan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 保留本人登记的拼写，不擅自改为Brian。不能仅凭英语名字推断对方的族群、国籍或宗教。
